components.html: HomeAboutServicesInsights
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; font-family: Outfit, Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav__link { position: relative; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #5c5668; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav__link:hover, .ds-nav__link.is-active { color: #1d1428; } .ds-nav__link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: #5f3393; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav__link:hover::after, .ds-nav__link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5f3393; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Drafting-table precision: grids, hairlines and measured purple ink. The site should feel like strategy you can see the structure of. A faint 88px architectural grid sits behind heroes and dark-tone bands; headlines are set in a tight geometric sans; colour is spent sparingly, so that Catalyst Plum and Blueprint Violet read as decisions, not decoration. Surfaces are light, calm and lilac-tinted, with depth expressed through soft, plum-tinted shadows and a cursor-following glow on cards rather than heavy fills.

Density is spacious and editorial: large type, generous section rhythm (96–128px), and short, confident copy. Motion is quiet and purposeful: content rises 10–14px into place with a strong ease-out, headlines come into focus from a light blur, and interactive feedback is immediate (press scale 0.97). Nothing bounces, nothing loops for attention except the very slow logo ring in the hero.

Confirmed rejections: the firm must never look like a social media agency (founder's direction). Gradient text is not used (removed on the Impeccable detector finding). Pill-shaped buttons, boxed labels and chip backgrounds were explicitly removed by the user.
keyCharacteristics: Light lilac-paper canvas with white cards and a faint plum blueprint grid.
Outfit geometric headlines (600, tight negative tracking) over Manrope body text.
One accent family: Catalyst Plum for fills and panels, Blueprint Violet for emphasis text, links, underlines and focus.
Squared controls (6px), soft card radii (24–32px), no pills.
Labels stand out through type alone: colour, weight, uppercase tracking, slashes and hairlines.
Subtle, interruptible motion with a strong ease-out and full reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Inverted Name Rule
rules.body: The codebase was built dark and re-themed by remapping tokens, so the Tailwind names are semantic, not literal: `white` is Boardroom Ink (foreground), `night` / `night-2` / `night-3` are Lilac Paper / Card White / Sunken Lilac, `glow` is Blueprint Violet, and `snow` is true white. `text-white` means ink; `border-white/10` is an ink hairline. Inside a Catalyst Plum panel, re-scope `--color-white: #ffffff` (and lighten `--color-haze` and `--color-glow`) on the panel so the same classes render white.

rules.name: The Spent Accent Rule
rules.body: Blueprint Violet marks one idea per block: the emphasised phrase, the active state, the next step. If more than about a tenth of a viewport is violet, it has stopped meaning anything.

rules.name: The Type-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Labels, tags and badges stand out through type alone: Blueprint Violet, weight, uppercase tracking, a leading hairline, or purple slash separators between items (`Strategic growth planning / Business development`). Never wrap them in chips, pills or tinted boxes.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Display size appears once per site, in the homepage hero. Everything else steps down to Headline.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with ink or plum, never pure black, and always long and soft (negative spread). A hard, short shadow breaks the blueprint calm.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: Nothing interactive is fully rounded. Pill buttons, pill tabs and pill chips were removed at the user's request and must not return.

dos: Do set emphasis words in Blueprint Violet as solid colour.
Do keep controls squared at 6px and containers soft at 24–32px.
Do let labels stand out through type: violet, weight, uppercase tracking, hairlines and slashes.
Do tint shadows with ink or plum and keep them long and soft.
Do use the strong ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`), keep UI transitions under 300ms, make exits faster than entrances, and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do re-scope `--color-white: #ffffff` inside Catalyst Plum panels instead of hard-coding white text.
Do keep the Digital Bae sub-brand bolder (Montserrat black) than the firm.
donts: Don't use pill-shaped buttons, pill tabs, chips with backgrounds, or boxed badges.
Don't add arrows to buttons other than the hero's primary call to action.
Don't put a background shape behind navbar links; the underline is the only indicator.
Don't read `text-white` or `bg-white` literally; they are Boardroom Ink (the Inverted Name Rule).
Don't use Lilac Haze for text on light surfaces.
Don't make the firm look like a social media agency: no stickers, emoji, neon or playful bounce.
